summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K reporting the signing of contracts with SBM Offshore for two FPSOs (SEAP II/P-87 and SEAP I/P-81) under a Build-Operate-Transfer model for the Sergipe Deepwater project. Petrobras will own the units; SBM Offshore will design, build, operate and maintain them for an initial 6.5 years. Petrobras’ investment exceeds R$60 billion. Production is scheduled to start in 2030-2031. This is an operational/industrial contract disclosure, not a transformative special situation. The filing does not involve a change of control, shareholder vote, or capital markets event. What to watch: project execution milestones and regulatory approvals.
